propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern in mutation-shards.toml selects all seven shards for any nested conftest change, regardless of whether that conftest is actually loaded by tests in those shards
Pytest loads only six conftests in ancestor chains (top-level plus five per-shard ancestors); unrelated sibling conftests like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py are never loaded
Seven proven over-trigger candidates across 97 completed Verify runs consumed 322.6 runner-minutes without increasing coverage
Mapping each non-root conftest only to shards whose configured tests load it eliminates false selections while retaining all fixture dependencies and test coverage
Contract asserting per-shard support closure equals derived ancestor conftests fails closed on missing dependencies or stale entries and was validated defect-seeded
Unrelated nested conftest changes now select zero shards; each ancestor-conftest change selects exactly its dependent shards
